view: PA (frontal) erect chest radiograph; conventional orientation confirmed by an "L" laterality marker at the image's upper right (patient's left shoulder)
technical_quality: Adequate. Minimal rotation (medial clavicular ends roughly equidistant from the spinous processes). Inspiration adequate (about 9 posterior ribs visible). Penetration adequate with vertebral bodies faintly seen through the cardiac shadow. Scapulae partly projected over the lateral upper lung fields. Both costophrenic angles and lung apices included.

devices.type: External laterality marker ("L" with arrow) and adjacent round metallic-density clip/button artifact
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image, projected over the patient's left shoulder soft tissues (outside the lung)
Left edge of the image (patient's right, outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined heterogeneous perihilar opacity extending from the left hilum inferolaterally into the lower zone, with a prominent/bulky left hilum; consolidation versus hilar mass with adjacent airspace change (in an 80-year-old, neoplasm should be excluded)
Increased retrocardiac density in the medial left lower zone, partially obscuring the medial left hemidiaphragm (lower lobe airspace opacity / atelectasis)
Prominent, unfolded and calcified aortic knob with mild widening of the upper mediastinum at the arch level, consistent with atherosclerotic/ectatic thoracic aorta
Mildly increased bronchovascular/interstitial markings at the right lung base
Degenerative changes of the thoracic spine (spondylosis) and glenohumeral joints

description_zh: 正面立位胸部X光，體位與曝露條件尚可，無旋轉，右上角可見「L」側別標記與外部圓形金屬密度小物件，胸腔內未見任何管路、導線或植入物。左側肺門區域可見邊界不清、密度不均之浸潤影，自肺門向下外側延伸至左下肺野，左肺門顯得腫大，並有左下肺後心區密度增加、內側橫膈輪廓部分模糊，需考慮左肺門周圍實質化，於高齡病人亦須排除肺門腫瘤合併阻塞性變化；右肺基底部支氣管血管紋理輕度增加，其餘右肺清晰，雙側肋膈角銳利，未見氣胸或明顯肋膜積液。心臟大小在正常上限，主動脈弓迂曲、突出並有鈣化，符合動脈硬化性主動脈；胸椎與雙側肩關節見退化性變化，骨質無明顯骨折或破壞。
